output.summary: Turnover rise is real (payroll-reconciled, same definitions) and far exceeds peers (+19 vs +5 points), so a migration artifact is contradicted. The monthly step occurs in March, when the all-branch two-Saturday policy began, before ShiftWise went live in April. Schedule-related exits rose from 19% to 48%, while pay was cited at a similar rate in both years. Market pay is unmeasured. Manager attribution is unreliable because the PeopleCore manager field is stale for the seven branches that changed managers. A 15% raise is costly and irreversible, so it is premature. The manager penalties are harmful. Get the branch-level and ShiftWise comparison and a pay benchmark before committing.
